MA-0.3 candidate for A to validate and C to review; not runtime evidence.
Final nodes end this activity invocation, not necessarily the case.
Only Domain Service commits case/attempt/notification state.
Every decision saves a receipt atomically; failed/unconfirmed writes
preserve prior durable facts and require the same HTTP key for recovery.
G-DISPATCH / G-ARTIFACT, recovery rules and open decisions are defined in docs/12.
